title: Alignment anchors — manager priming lab book
content:
Purpose: lightweight scratchbook to prime my manager sync + mid-quarter self-evidence. Not polished — notes to self, examples, and a few hypotheses to test in 1:1s.

High-level ask for next manager sync (15m):
- Align on 3 concrete outcomes I should own by end of Q2. Narrow scope > breadth.
- Confirm hiring ramp expectations for contractor support (2 vs 4 weeks).
- Agree success metrics for the coaching experiment (see metrics section).

Current framing (working):
- Role focus: coaching + enablement for IC growth, streamline onboarding flows, small-scale policy cleanup for interview calibration.
- Why it matters: reduces time-to-contribution for new hires, increases manager confidence in calibration conversations, and builds repeatable coaching patterns across teams.

3 draft goals (for discussion) — each with quick evidence/actions:
1) Coaching cadence pilot (Team A) — run 6 cohort coaching cycles by June 30
   - Evidence: attendance roster, 3x post-cohort feedback forms with median NPS >= 7, two documented promotions that reference coaching artifacts
   - Current status: recruited 8 participants, 2 sessions delivered, feedback mixed (requests for clearer exercises)
   - To-do: finalize week-by-week activity sheet, record one sample session for manager to review

2) Onboarding triage reduction — reduce first-30-day backlog tickets by 40% for new hires
   - Evidence: dashboard query (HR-bootcamp backlog) showing ticket counts vs baseline
   - Current status: baseline data pulled (Feb); need to instrument event that tags "onboarding-blocker" automatically
   - To-do: sync with infra (ticket tagging), propose 2 playbook triggers for managers

3) Calibration handbook draft — 12 interview rubrics contextualized by role families
   - Evidence: doc with rubrics, two calibration sessions with hiring managers showing improved inter-rater agreement
   - Current status: two role families drafted (SWE, SRE)
   - To-do: schedule pilot calibration with Platform and Product hiring managers; incorporate feedback loop

Quick wins to mention in 1:1 (bullet list):
- Short coaching toolkit template created and used by 3 managers (link above).
- Reduced candidate feedback lag from 4 days -> 2.5 days in pilot loop.
- One-off blocker: vendor contract renewal delayed interview prep package (raised to finance).

Behavioral evidence to surface (concrete examples) — pick 2 for this sync:
- "Manager X reused our coaching exercise and reported a 30% uptick in direct report confidence." (email excerpt: sent Jan 15 — include as appendix)
- "Reduced candidate turnaround" — attach screenshot of ATS metric for week of Feb 9

Risks / asks (be explicit):
- Risk: if contractor onboarding delayed, coaching pilot capacity drops by 40% — ask: expedite SOW approval (JIRA-HR-342).
- Risk: Instrumentation gap for onboarding tickets — ask: timeboxed help from infra (2 days).

Coaching experiment metrics (proposal):
- Participation rate: % of invited ICs who complete 4+ sessions
- Activation: % of attendees who run at least one 1:1 with a manager using the toolkit within 30 days
- Outcome proxy: self-reported confidence delta (pre/post survey) and manager-reported behavioral change examples

Manager conversation script (6–8 minutes):
- Opening: "Quick update on coaching pilot + two blockers where I need your unblock."
- Show 30s summary of progress + one participant quote
- Ask #1: SOW approval timeline (contractor)
- Ask #2: Permission to run pilot calibration with Platform hiring managers next Wed (need 40 minutes and 3 managers)
- Close: "If both are OK, I can run a 15-min status update next week showing the scheduling and baseline metrics."

Evidence folder checklist (what to attach to the 1:1 agenda):
- Participant feedback forms (anonymized)
- ATS screenshot for candidate turnaround
- Draft calibration handbook (two sample rubrics)
- Email excerpt from Manager X praising toolkit

Personal growth notes (to reflect on during sync):
- Need to be more comfortable asking for concrete operational time (block calendar) rather than vague help.
- Improve storytelling: practice one-minute "why this matters" for each initiative.
- Experiment: bring one prototype artifact to every 1:1 and ask for 1 piece of feedback (aim for 2 actionable items).

Follow-ups after this sync (placeholders):
- If SOW approved: onboard contractor week of Mar 16 — plan first 2 sessions with extra facilitator capacity.
- If infra help granted: run ticket-tagging implementation Mar 12–13 and validate metrics by Mar 20.

Hypotheses to test in next 6 weeks (note-form):
- H1: Short, modular coaching exercises increase manager adoption vs 90-min workshops (measure adoption rate).
- H2: Formalizing "first blockers" tag reduces manual triage time by 25%.
- H3: Co-created calibration rubrics improve hiring manager confidence more than centrally authored rubrics.

Open questions (to raise if there's time):
- Where does leadership prefer prioritization to fall between onboarding vs calibration vs coaching?
- Is there appetite for a cross-functional pilot with Sales (fast ramp context)?
- What guardrails do we want for coach-facilitator role so managers don't rely on us for every 1:1?

Random drafting scratch (delete later):
- Sample one-liner for handbook: "Calibration is an investment: 30 minutes now avoids a week of mis-hiring later."
- Quick exercise idea: "Two-minute evidence" — volunteer brings one concrete hire example and others practise asking clarifying questions for 5 minutes.

Notes-to-self: prioritize tidy artifacts over long narratives. Managers respond better to a one-pager + clear ask.

End of scratchbook entry.

(If this is useful, copy a subset into the '1:1 agenda' Google doc and attach evidentiary artifacts.)
